name: orphan-process
notes: PID 800 exits at T+4s and its child PID 900 is observed with PPID 1 from T+6s.
The reparent edge requires the recorded PPID lineage, not mere adjacency and not the child's PID range.
The parent exit is the failure anchor; its own cause is UNKNOWN, and the known chain is exit -> reparent (MEDIUM edge). The incident trigger is not a cause.

Re-audit 2026-10-28 (principal, causal-semantics.md §5.2 clarified): a failure is never its own candidate, and an escalation-only path is the anchor's own episode (known chain), not a contributing factor. Suspected-kill/write-failure alternatives explain exit failures only, never a condition anchor.
